custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test.
  • Create an open purchase order for this test, purchase order 1, from any vendor, with two lines, neither received: one for part A picked from the lookup, and one where part A's number was typed by hand and added as typed, with no link to the part.
  • Use a new part number that no part and no Part Library entry has yet, and that does not contain part A's number.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

Setup

  1. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C839446 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839446-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Quantity (in the bin row): 1. Click Save.
  2. Make the purchase order: Click Parts in the top bar, Purchase Orders in the left menu, then New PO. Pick any Vendor. Type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839446-A in Part Number and pick part A from the list. Type 1 in Quantity, click Add, then click Save & Close. Do not click Receive. Before Save & Close add a second line: type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839446-A in Part Number again, keep it as typed without picking a result, type 1 in Quantity and click Add.
